correctness.rationale: Expanding U(t)=sum exp(i theta t)E_theta and Cesàro-averaging gives Mhat=sum E_theta∘E_theta. Primitive SRG projector entries are constant on diagonal, edges and nonedges; independently simplified m=(-k-(n-1)s)/(r-s), n=(k-r)(k-s)/(k+rs), and resulting d-f+(e-f)r to the displayed rational expression Λ_r=[r²+s(s+2)]/(r-s)²−2r(s+1)/[(k−r)(r−s)] exactly (SymPy difference zero). For primitive SRG restricted r>0 and s<-1; integer case gives r>=1,s<=-2. In the nonintegral Galois-conjugate case m=p implies r+s=-1, k=(n-1)/2 and conference parameters; n>=9 again r>=1,s<=-2, with n=5=C_5 direct. Both terms of Λ_r are nonnegative with strict positive second term; complement swaps restricted eigenspaces without changing projector Schur squares, implying Λ_s>0 too. Principal eigenvalue=1 and C_5 Λ_r=Λ_s=1/5. This is a proof for all feasible primitive SRG, not extrapolated from example scripts.

final_claim: For every finite primitive strongly regular graph (G and its complement connected), the ordinary uniform-in-time Cesàro quantum average mixing matrix is positive definite of rank n, with positive nonprincipal eigenvalues from explicit SRG spectral formulas and complement symmetry (including exceptional C_5).
limitations: Assumes both SRG and its complement connected; imprimitive cases and diameter>=3 omitted.
